title: The Feast of the Serpent King
text: In a hall of scales a crowned man sits with a serpent growing from each shoulder. The serpents watch you with flat, hungry eyes while he smiles. He offers you a long life, as long as his own, if you will feed his serpents a little of what you know.

options.label: Kneel, and let the serpents feed on what you know, for a life as long as his.

outcomes.text: The serpents feed politely. You walk out sound in body but emptier behind the eyes, unable to recall what was taken.

options.label: Refuse him, and keep a close eye on the serpents.

outcomes.text: The serpents rise first, hissing. The King rises after them, still smiling.

options.label: Take the long life and feed them nothing. Let them go hungry.

outcomes.text: The Leader takes the gift and offers the serpents nothing. The King smiles, his serpents with him, and lets you go.
The serpents strike before the Leader can pull away. They feed deeply, taking more than they were owed.
